resources.string:
Fahrtenplan collects the location of your vehicle while you are logged in as a driver – also when the app is closed or not in use (in the background).

Your employer's dispatch uses it to see where the vehicle is, to tell customers the expected arrival time and to document the routes driven. Location sharing stops when you log out. A notification is shown whenever the location is being transmitted.

On the next screen, please allow location access and then choose «Allow all the time».
So that your location is transmitted reliably even with the screen locked: in the app settings, open «Battery» and choose «Unrestricted» (or «Don\'t optimise»).
